title: Ο περί Εταιρειών (Τροποποιητικός) (Αρ. 3) Νόμος του 2025 (Companies (Amendment) (No. 3) Law of 2025), transposing CSRD into Cap. 113
citation: Law 162(I)/2025, Official Gazette Annex I(I) No. 5051 of 2025-07-29
evidence: Header of the law: "Ο περί Εταιρειών (Τροποποιητικός) (Αρ. 3) Νόμος του 2025 εκδίδεται με δημοσίευση στην Επίσημη Εφημερίδα της Κυπριακής Δημοκρατίας σύμφωνα με το Άρθρο 52 του Συντάγματος." Gazette Annex I Part I No. 5051 of 29.7.2025; no separate commencement clause found, so in force on publication. Opened https://www.mof.gov.cy/mof/gpo/gazette.nsf/All/ADB5F123967FEA15C2258CD6002F9C3B?OpenDocument and its PDF on 2026-11-02.
notes: Preamble: harmonisation with Articles 1 and 5 of Directive (EU) 2022/2464 and Article 1 of Directive (EU) 2025/794. Amends the Companies Law Cap. 113. Companion laws in the same gazette issue: cy-auditors-amendment-2025 (160(I)) and cy-transparency-amendment-2-2025 (161(I)). The consolidated Cap. 113 is not in scope: only CyLaw (a bar association, row CY-CYLAW-CONSOLIDATED, permission requested) serves a consolidation, and no state body does. No government English text found: looked for on mof.gov.cy/gpo (the English pages of the gazette site carry no law text) and on cylaw.org (bar association, English only for some judgments).

citation: Law 110(I)/2011, Official Gazette Annex I(I) No. 4290 of 2011-07-29
evidence: The GPO page lists Annex I Part I No. 4290 dated Παρασκευή 29/07/2011, but the PDF at that page is an image scan with no text layer (pdftotext returned 134 characters), so no official page text states the law number or an in-force date. The pairing of Law 110(I)/2011 with gazette 4290 comes from the CyLaw index (https://www.cylaw.org/nomoi/indexes/2011_1_110.html).
notes: EU ETS member: Directive 2003/87/EC applies through this law and its amendments, and no record of the directive is held. Replaced Law 132(I)/2004 (CyLaw lists 110(I)/2011 as repealing it). The date 2011-07-29 is the gazette issue date only.
